purpose: Teach: 総体/元祖/置き場/アウトソーシング/空調/積立/延べ/一様

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界総体の動向を分析しろ
lines.en: Analyze the industry trends for us.
lines.style: Direct, clipped delivery. Minimal inflection. Authority rests in brevity. Weight on the verb — not a request, an instruction. Eyes level, hands steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、元祖と呼ばれる商品の改良を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll proceed with refining our flagship product line.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice. Not obsequious — professional, competent. Steady pace. Clear intention to execute.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、倉庫の置き場を整理しろ
lines.style: Quick, efficient. No softening. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed. Slight pause after the verb, like checking it landed. Posture: unmoved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理業務のアウトソーシングを検討します
lines.en: Yes. We're looking into outsourcing the accounting operations.
lines.style: Calm report-back. Slightly faster than the previous line — moving forward. No hesitation. Professional distance maintained. Hands occupied with note-taking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: オフィスの空調設備を更新しろ
lines.en: Update the office air conditioning system.
lines.style: Flat, practical instruction. No drama. The tone of someone who manages infrastructure like he manages people — with efficiency. Brief. Factual weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員退職金の積立計画を見直します
lines.en: Yes. We're reviewing the employee retirement benefit accrual plan.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Formal register — this is administrative substance. Delivered without apology. Slightly more considered pace than before. Professional sincerity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 延べ来場者数を把握しろ
lines.style: Sharp, singular focus. No elaboration. The voice of someone assigning work that matters. Slight lean forward in the delivery. Expectant pause at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に一様な機会を提供します
lines.en: Understood. We'll ensure all staff have equal access to development opportunities.
lines.style: Thoughtful conclusion. Slower than the previous acknowledgment — this one carries weight. Slight warmth here, almost imperceptible. The close of an exchange, not an interruption.
